title: Reviews
description: the review invitations that a user may issue to another user

filmId.description: unique identifier of the film for which a review invitation has been issued

reviewerId.description: unique identifier of the user who has received the review invitation

completed.description: a Boolean property, set to true if the review has been completed, false otherwise

reviewDate.description: the date when the review was completed

rating.description: the rating the reviewer has given to the film

review.description: the textual review the reviewer has given to the film
